verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly describe spawning multiple coordinated agents, running multiple parallel sessions, kicking off long-running/scheduled tasks, and cloud/remote sessions that persist without local presence (docs-6,8,9,10,13,14,26), directly supporting the story. However, this is entirely vendor-sourced; community evidence focuses on quality/reliability issues over time (degradation, failure modes) rather than confirming true multi-day autonomous fleet operation, so independent validation of 'hours or days' unattended parallel autonomy is missing.
